headline: Congress takes a breather with both chambers in recess ahead of key judicial confirmation vote

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met briefly in pro forma session on Friday morning and adjourned until Tuesday. The chamber is preparing to resume consideration of Angela Veronica Colmenero's nomination to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas.

onTheFloor.title: Nomination of Angela Veronica Colmenero to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas
onTheFloor.status: Cloture vote scheduled for 5:30 PM Tuesday

house.lastSessionSummary: The House was not in session Friday. The chamber will convene in pro forma session Monday morning before the recess period continues.
